name: Ha'Shash | 1.1g Live Resin Infused Preroll | Sugar Cookies
description:
Hashash Live Resin Infused – 1g Premium Pre-Roll

Elevate your experience with Hashash Live Resin Infused pre-rolls – where craftsmanship meets unmatched potency. Each 1-gram pre-roll is expertly packed with top-shelf flower and infused with premium live resin, delivering a smooth, flavorful smoke and a powerful, full-spectrum high.

The live resin injection enhances both flavor and strength, capturing the plant’s true terpene profile and boosting THC content for a fast-acting, long-lasting effect. Whether you're unwinding after a long day or looking for a next-level session, Hashash Live Resin Infused offers the kind of potent, terp-rich experience that cannabis enthusiasts crave.

Highlights:

1 gram of high-quality flower per pre-roll
Infused with premium live resin for boosted potency
Rich terpene flavor and full-spectrum effects
Perfect for seasoned users seeking a stronger hit
Hashash – Roll up. Light up. Level up.
